id.description: A unique identifier for the connection.

displayName.description: The display name of the PSTN connection.

pstnServices.description: The PSTN services available for this connection.

pstnConnectionType.description: The PSTN connection type set for the location.

routeType.description: Premise route type. This is required if connection type is LOCAL_GATEWAY.

routeId.description: Premise route ID. This refers to either a Trunk ID or a Route Group ID. This field is optional but required if the connection type is LOCAL_GATEWAY.
